ordered_diagnoses: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

s1.syndrome_frame: Middle-aged man with chest pain, dyspnea, and significant weight loss, with a complex mediastinal mass and multiple pulmonary nodules
salient_findings: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
FDG uptake in multiple pulmonary nodules, hilar lymph nodes, and a pleural-based lesion
key_facts: Normal complete blood count and comprehensive metabolic profile
Retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass measuring 1.2 × 8.6 × 10.7 cm
Mass effect on the esophagus, left atrium, and pulmonary veins
Benign bronchial cells on transbronchial needle aspiration
Spindle cell neoplasm on EUS-guided FNA
Positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
No mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA
FDG uptake in multiple pulmonary nodules, hilar lymph nodes, and a pleural-based lesion

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a spindle cell neoplasm and positive germline testing for NF1, which is associated with neurofibromatosis type 1

shortlist.label: Thymic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Complex mediastinal mass and multiple pulmonary nodules, which could be consistent with thymic carcinoma

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a spindle cell neoplasm and significant weight loss, which could be consistent with sarcomatoid carcinoma

shortlist.why_kept: Complex mediastinal mass and multiple pulmonary nodules, which could be consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic malignant fibrous histiocytoma

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a spindle cell neoplasm, which could be consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a pleural-based lesion and a spindle cell neoplasm, which could be consistent with solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
